items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: Grant arranged it, see, and Alberta made it

ctx.x: Well, Grant arranged it, see, and Alberta made it, and it was for the Black Swan Records, and they were owned by Pace...Pace and...I think Pace and Handy, if I'm not mistaken-- Handy's brother, and Fletcher Henderson was the music...was head of the music department.
What year did you write "Someday Sweetheart"?
